report_name: AI-Assisted Cybercrime: Actor 'BUGSTER' Abuses AI Tools

threat_actors.name: BUGSTER
threat_actors.description: An AI-assisted threat actor actively weaponizing jailbroken AI tools, including the Hermes Agent framework and DeepSeek V4 model, to plan and execute cybercrimes. The actor's activities include credential theft, data exfiltration, and planning VoIP fraud, primarily targeting entities in India.
threat_actors.goals: Credential theft, data exfiltration of PII, and planning for large-scale VoIP fraud.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The actor used AI-generated reconnaissance to perform methodical enumeration of a target university's WordPress REST API.

attack_patterns.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
attack_patterns.description: An AI-generated brute-force campaign was launched against a university's WordPress website to gain access.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The actor's goal was to acquire valid user credentials through brute-force attacks on a university website.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: The actor exfiltrated a MongoDB database containing over 5,200 student records from a compromised university network.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: The actor used a 'win_shell.ps1' payload, indicating the use of PowerShell for executing a reverse shell.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell
attack_patterns.description: The actor used a 'win_shell.bat' payload, suggesting the use of the Windows Command Shell for reverse shell execution.

attack_patterns.name: Acquire Infrastructure: Virtual Private Server
attack_patterns.description: The actor used Vast.ai cloud GPU instances for cracking Wi-Fi passwords, which constitutes acquiring third-party infrastructure.

tools.name: Hermes Agent
tools.description: An AI framework combined with the DeepSeek V4 model, used by BUGSTER with disabled safety controls to get step-by-step guidance for attacks.

tools.name: DeepSeek V4
tools.description: An AI model used within the Hermes Agent framework by BUGSTER, with safety controls disabled, to plan and get guidance for cybercriminal operations.

tools.name: Vast.ai
tools.description: A cloud GPU provider used by BUGSTER to offload the cracking process for Wi-Fi passwords.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.description: The IDE used by the threat actor BUGSTER as their development environment.

tools.name: Kali Linux
tools.description: The operating system used by BUGSTER on a local device to capture Wi-Fi handshakes before offloading them for cracking.

identities.name: Indian Universities
identities.description: Universities in India targeted by the threat actor BUGSTER. One university's WordPress site was targeted with a brute-force campaign, and another had a MongoDB database with over 5,200 student records exfiltrated.

infrastructure.name: BUGSTER C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A Python-based C2 listener used by BUGSTER to support reverse shells delivered via win_shell.ps1 and win_shell.bat payloads.

infrastructure.name: Vast.ai Cracking Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Cloud GPU instances on Vast.ai acquired by BUGSTER to offload and execute Wi-Fi password cracking operations.

indicators.name: BUGSTER Reverse Shell Payloads
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: BUGSTER Reverse Shell Payloads
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of reverse shell payloads used by the BUGSTER threat actor.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-assisted-cybercrime-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-10-22'
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\win_shell.ps1'
      - '\win_shell.bat'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of Windows PowerShell and Batch script reverse shell payloads named `win_shell.ps1` and `win_shell.bat`, used by the BUGSTER threat actor.

indicators.name: BUGSTER AI-Generated Attack Report String
indicators.pattern:
title: BUGSTER AI-Generated Attack Report String
id: e2f3a4b5-c6d7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects a unique string 'NEXT EXPLOIT OPPORTUNITIES' found in an LLM-generated attack report used by the BUGSTER threat actor. This rule is conceptual and requires a backend capable of file content inspection.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-assisted-cybercrime-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-10-22'
tags:
  - attack.t1005
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  keywords:
    - 'NEXT EXPLOIT OPPORTUNITIES'
  condition: keywords
indicators.description: Detects the unique string 'NEXT EXPLOIT OPPORTUNITIES' within files, which was found in an LLM-generated attack report used by BUGSTER.

indicators.name: BUGSTER AI and Cracking Infrastructure
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: BUGSTER AI and Cracking Infrastructure DNS Query
id: d3e4f5a6-b7c8-4c9d-8e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to domains associated with AI services (DeepSeek) and cloud GPU providers (Vast.ai) used by the BUGSTER threat actor.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-assisted-cybercrime-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-10-22'
tags:
  - attack.t1583.003
  - attack.resource_development
level: medium
logsource:
  category: dns_query
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - 'api.deepseek.com'
      - 'vast.ai'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to domains associated with AI services (DeepSeek) and cloud GPU providers (Vast.ai) used by BUGSTER.

indicators.name: WordPress User Enumeration via REST API
indicators.pattern:
title: WordPress User Enumeration via REST API
id: c4d5e6f7-a8b9-4d0e-9f2a-3b4c5d6e7f8a
status: experimental
description: Detects requests to the WordPress REST API endpoint for user enumeration, a technique used by BUGSTER in brute-force attacks. High volume should be alerted on.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-assisted-cybercrime-analysis/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: '2026-10-22'
tags:
  - attack.t1595
  - attack.reconnaissance
level: low
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/wp-json/wp/v2/users'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web requests to the WordPress REST API endpoint `/wp-json/wp/v2/users`, which is used for user enumeration and was leveraged by BUGSTER.

relationships.target_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

relationships.source_name: WordPress User Enumeration via REST API
